zh.title: 修复移动端时间条拖动
zh.summary: 修复按钮透明区域遮挡 Windy 时间条的问题，保留原有紧凑布局。

items.text: 修复移动端圆形控制按钮及关闭按钮的透明区域挡住 Windy 时间条拖动的问题，保留原有按钮位置与紧凑布局。

en.title: Mobile timeline dragging fix
en.summary: Fixed transparent button areas blocking Windy’s timeline while preserving the compact layout.

items.text: Fixed transparent areas around mobile circular controls and the close button blocking Windy timeline dragging, while keeping the existing button positions and compact layout.
